+def _quota_intervals(data):
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"]
+            if job["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+    k = data["k"]
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for chosen in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in chosen))
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in chosen:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(chosen, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["start"] < ordered[i - 1]["end"]
+               for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and ids > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+

+def _temporal_routes(data):
+    import heapq
+
+    required_bits = {node: 1 << i
+                     for i, node in enumerate(data.get("required", []))}
+    full_mask = (1 << len(required_bits)) - 1
+    source = data["source"]
+    target = data["target"]
+    initial = (source, required_bits.get(source, 0), data["coupons"])
+    distances = {initial: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"],) + initial]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:

+        if distances.get(state) != arrival:

+        if node == target and mask == full_mask and remaining == 0:
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+
